raw_segments.text: After four years of this life, I chanced to be in the town of Kay where our regiment was stationed at the time.
We found the people of the town hospitable, rich, and fond of entertainments.
I met with a cordial reception everywhere as I was of a lively temperament and was known to be well off,
which always goes a long way in the world. And then a circumstance happened which was the beginning of it all.
